channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: TSE adia decisão sobre pesquisa AtlasIntel que indicou queda de Flávio
item.description: TSE Minister Nunes Marques provisionally suspended the release of an AtlasIntel poll showing declining voter intentions for Flávio Bolsonaro, accepting PL's argument that the survey contained eight leading questions tied to the Banco Master scandal and based on unverified audio. Minister Estela Aranha requested a view, delaying the full court's decision on whether to uphold the injunction. AtlasIntel defended the poll, expressing confidence in the TSE's technical review.

item.title: Ministro do TSE diz que 2022 é “atestado de confiabilidade” das urnas
item.description: TSE Minister Floriano de Azevedo Marques stated that the electronic voting machines from the 2022 elections underwent rigorous testing and investigations, with no irregularities found, serving as an 'attestation of seriousness and reliability'. He noted that questioning the vote count is not illicit, but the 2022 investigation requests were deemed bad-faith litigation, and that claims of urn unreliability are becoming discredited ahead of the 2026 elections.

item.title: Ministra do TSE pede vista e adia julgamento sobre pesquisa da AtlasIntel
item.description: Minister Estella Aranha of the TSE requested a view and postponed the ruling on the validity of the AtlasIntel poll showing declining popularity for Flávio Bolsonaro, following an audio linking him to Banco Master founder Daniel Vorcaro. Relator Minister Kássio Nunes Marques voted to invalidate the poll, claiming it attempted to influence respondents by associating the senator with financial fraud, constituting political bias and overstepping polling boundaries. The suspension of the poll on official websites remains pending Aranha’s forthcoming vote.

item.title: TSE mantém suspensão de pesquisa com áudio contra Flávio, mas adia decisão
item.description: Justice Nunes Marques of the TSE voted to maintain the suspension of the AtlasIntel poll conducted after the release of audio involving Senator Flávio Bolsonaro and former banker Daniel Vorcaro. However, Justice Estela Aranha requested more time for analysis, postponing the final decision.

item.title: Nunes Marques vota por manter pesquisa suspensa e ministra pede vista
item.description: Minister Kassio Nunes Marques voted to maintain the suspension of the AtlasIntel poll showing declining voting intentions for Senator Flávio Bolsonaro after revelations of sponsorship of the film Dark Horse by banker Daniel Vorcaro. The judgment was interrupted when Minister Estela Aranha requested a view of the process. The poll had been suspended due to potential economic power abuse and undue influence in the campaign.

item.title: Toffoli assume vaga como ministro do TSE
item.description: Minister Dias Toffoli assumed a seat on the Superior Electoral Court (TSE) on June 9, 2026, returning after 14 years, replacing Cármen Lúcia. The swearing-in ceremony took place during a TSE session with STF justices and the electoral prosecutor general present, highlighting his pioneering role in implementing Brazil’s electoral biometric system. The TSE is now fully constituted for the 2026 general elections.

item.title: Pedido de vista interrompe julgamento no TSE sobre decisão de Nunes Marques que suspendeu pesquisa após pedido de Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: The TSE's judgment on President Kássio Nunes Marques' decision to suspend an AtlasIntel poll on Flávio Bolsonaro was halted after a request for vista by Minister Estela Aranha, leaving the injunction blocking the poll's publication in place. The suspension was based on concerns that the questionnaire influenced responses by referencing an audio of the senator discussing funding for the film 'Dark Horse'. AtlasIntel denies inducement and claims other institutes found similar electoral impact patterns.

item.title: Com campanha sob pressão após caso 'Dark Horse', Flávio Bolsonaro endurece tom na segurança e defende castração química
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro intensified his public security rhetoric following the 'Dark Horse' scandal, advocating for lowering the age of criminal responsibility, chemical castration for sex offenders, and designating PCC and CV as terrorist organizations by the U.S. He also criticized the federal government's stance on agribusiness and pledged stronger support for rural producers under a future Bolsonaro-led administration.

item.title: Governo vai defender que deputados da base votem contra a redução da maioridade penal para 16 anos
item.description: The Lula government will direct ruling coalition deputies to vote against the PEC lowering the age of criminal responsibility from 18 to 16, aiming to avoid appearing lenient on crime during an election year. Although the PT historically opposes the measure, Justice Minister Wellington César Lima e Silva advocates for a reexamination, noting varying maturity levels and Parliament’s right to debate. The proposal, backed by rapporteur Coronel Assis (PL-MT), will be voted on in the CCJ this Tuesday.

item.title: PEC do fim da 6 X 1 deve ir à CCJ na próxima semana, diz Randolfe
item.description: Senator Randolfe Rodrigues (PT-AP) announced that the PEC to end the 6x1 work scale will be sent to the Senate's CCJ next week for expedited voting in a single committee. He said there is favorable support to reduce the 14-month transition period, arguing workers have waited 150 years for this change. He dismissed compensatory measures like payroll tax exemptions and opposed the opposition's Flexible Work Hours PEC, calling it a 'reestablishment of slave labor'.

item.title: Por que Lula não vai à missa? Janja rebate Malafaia e PT lança carta para evangélicos
item.description: First Lady Janja explained during the 4th National Meeting of Evangelicals of the PT why President Lula avoids attending public masses, citing security concerns and respect for presidential protocols. She also rebutted recent criticisms from Pastor Silas Malafaia, defending the government's stance toward the evangelical community. The PT launched a manifesto aimed at Christian voters to broaden its support within this demographic.

item.title: Pedido de vista adia análise do TSE de decisão que suspendeu pesquisa que mostrou queda de intenção de votos de Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: The TSE suspended the judgment on the individual decision by Minister Kassio Nunes Marques that ordered the removal of an AtlasIntel poll showing a five-point drop in Flávio Bolsonaro's voting intentions. Minister Estela Aranha's request for a vista halted the analysis, keeping the poll's suspension in effect until further review. The case sparked debate among ministers regarding its electoral impact and the need for dialogue with polling institutes.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro faz campanha em reduto do pai na Bahia e critica governo Lula
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) visited Luís Eduardo Magalhães in Bahia during the Bahia Farm Show to strengthen his electoral base in one of the last Bolsonarist strongholds in the state. He praised rural producers' support, criticized the Lula government for treating agribusiness as 'fascist' and 'criminal', and pledged to combat narcoterrorism, aligning with the U.S. designation of PCC and Comando Vermelho as terrorist organizations.

item.title: Senado aprova proteção a trabalhadores resgatados de trabalho escravo
item.description: The Senate approved bill PL 5760/2023, which establishes protections for workers rescued from conditions analogous to slavery, including access to unemployment insurance, inclusion in the CadÚnico social registry, amendments to the Maria da Penha Law for emergency shelter, and authorization for labor auditors to enter residences without a court order when exploitation is suspected. The bill also provides urgent protective measures for domestic workers, particularly women, and awaits presidential sanction.

item.title: Toffoli toma posse como ministro efetivo do TSE
item.description: Minister Dias Toffoli was sworn in as an effective member of the Superior Electoral Court (TSE) on Tuesday, the 9th, filling the vacancy left by former Court president Minister Cármen Lúcia. His appointment is strategically timed to allow the new TSE president, Kassio Nunes Marques, more time to lead the court before and during the 2026 elections.

item.title: Câmara aprova regime de urgência para 18 projetos
item.description: The Chamber of Deputies approved urgency regime for 18 bills, allowing direct voting in the Plenary without prior committee review. The proposals include measures on cybercrime penalties, women's integral health policy, national laboratory diagnostics in SUS, protection against gender-based political violence, public sector labor relations, extension of tax benefits for merchant navy, infrastructure financing in Northern, Northeastern and Central-Western regions, indigenous adaptation protocol in risk situations, and credit expansion for Brazilian exporters.

item.title: Defesa de Bolsonaro pede visita de nora e netas no dia em que Brasil estreia na Copa do Mundo
item.description: Bolsonaro's defense requested STF permission for his daughter-in-law and two minor granddaughters to visit him on June 13, the date of Brazil's 2026 World Cup opener. Bolsonaro has been under house arrest since March following bacterial pneumonia and was sentenced in September 2025 to 27 years and 3 months for his role in a coup attempt. The request was submitted to Minister Alexandre de Moraes.

item.title: Governo se reúne com Alcolumbre para tentar barrar ‘pautas-bomba’
item.description: The Lula government met with Senate President Davi Alcolumbre to block so-called 'bombshell' bills feared by the economic team, including rural debt renegotiation (R$120B), full pension parity for health agents, a new minimum wage for doctors and dentists (R$47B), and an increase in municipal fund transfers (R$10B in 2026). The meeting took place amid strained relations between Lula and Alcolumbre following the rejection of Jorge Messias’ STF nomination, with Durigan and Guimarães acting as political intermediaries.

item.title: Dino multa Estados e municípios por falta de transparência em emendas
item.description: Supreme Court Minister Flávio Dino ordered daily fines of 1% on received Pix amendment funds for states and municipalities failing to ensure transparency and traceability, including submission of Work Plans and management reports via Transferegov.br. The MGI has 10 days to identify irregularities and notify non-compliant entities, while the CGU has 5 business days to present an audit schedule for amendments from 2020 to 2024. Fines collected will fund audits by MGI and CGU, particularly targeting opaque allocations to the events sector.

item.title: PT lança 'Porta-Vozes do Lula', iniciativa com missões e ranking digital de apoiadores
item.description: The PT launched 'Porta-Vozes do Lula,' an initiative to organize digital militants in defense of the government and coordinate actions against opponents. The program includes missions and a digital ranking to engage supporters of President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva.

item.title: TSE julga decisão de Nunes Marques que suspendeu pesquisa com queda de Flávio
item.description: The TSE ruled on Minister Nunes Marques' decision to suspend the publication of an electoral poll showing a decline in Flávio Bolsonaro, granting a request from the PL party, which claimed the poll induced negative voter responses. The Court president ordered the institute to remove the data, stating the issue does not concern freedom of expression but compliance with specific electoral poll regulations.

item.title: PT lança ‘Porta-Vozes do Lula’, iniciativa com missões e ranking digital de apoiadores do presidente
item.description: The PT launched 'Porta-Vozes do Lula', an initiative to organize digital militants in defense of the government, combat misinformation, and mobilize supporters through daily missions and a points-based ranking. The project includes members from the PT, PCdoB, PSOL, PSB, and other allied parties, using WhatsApp groups and social media content to spread messages. The first mission is to recruit new participants, with points awarded for referrals.

item.title: Lula vai explorar ‘ligações perigosas’ entre Flávio e Vorcaro com time de influenciadores digitais
item.description: Lula's campaign plans to use digital influencers and groups called 'Lula's Spokespersons' to spread positive content about his government and attack Flávio Bolsonaro, leveraging the World Cup period. The strategy involves holding back robust allegations about dangerous links between Flávio and Daniel Vorcaro — including a purported video and financial negotiations for the film 'Dark Horse' — for the final days of the campaign, while audio recordings and spreadsheets already link funds to expenses for Bolsonaro's relatives.

item.title: Ao vivo: TSE analisa veto de Nunes Marques a pesquisa da AtlasIntel
item.description: The TSE is reviewing whether an AtlasIntel poll violated electoral law by linking voter intention to conversations about money requests for a film about former President Bolsonaro. Minister Kássio Nunes Marques ordered the suspension of the poll’s dissemination and demanded methodological explanation within 2 days, responding to a request from Senator Flávio Bolsonaro. The preliminary ruling affects the poll registered as BR-06939/2026, released on May 19.

item.title: STF retoma julgamento sobre perdão a partidos por descumprimento de cotas raciais
item.description: The STF resumes judgment on the constitutionality of EC 133, which pardons parties for failing to meet racial quotas in electoral funding. The 2024 amendment reduced mandatory funding for Black and brown candidates and created a party debt refinancing program. With 6 votes in favor of upholding the law and 3 against, the case returns to the virtual docket from June 19–26 after Justice Alexandre de Moraes returned the case files.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro promete reduzir maioriade penal e aprovar castração química para estuprador
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro, pre-candidate for president from the PL party, promised during a speech at the Bahia Farm Show to reduce the age of criminal responsibility and approve chemical castration for rapists, while also combating land invasions and strengthening support for agribusiness. He reaffirmed his commitment to maintain and expand the Bolsa Família program, attributing its increase during the pandemic to his father Jair Bolsonaro’s government.

item.title: Governo prevê cerca de R$ 4 bilhões em linha de crédito para entregadores
item.description: The federal government plans to allocate R$ 4 billion in subsidized credit for motorcycle delivery workers, targeting those who have worked for platforms like iFood for at least six months. The financing will offer reduced interest rates, backed by a guarantee fund, and can be used to purchase new or used motorcycles, including electric models, with repayments deducted directly from workers’ bank accounts. The measure is part of an electoral goodwill package and awaits final adjustments, though President Lula aims to announce it this month.

item.title: Disputas sobre pesquisas serão “constantes”, diz ministro do TSE
item.description: TSE Minister Floriano de Azevedo Marques stated that disputes over electoral polls will be constant in the 2026 election, referencing the suspension of an AtlasIntel poll on Flávio Bolsonaro ordered by Minister Nunes Marques due to allegations of manipulation. He said such bans are not common but not rare, and the TSE plenary will assess on Tuesday whether the poll violated electoral law.

item.title: Tarcísio oficializa repasse para a Saúde de todos os municípios de SP
item.description: Governor Tarcísio de Freitas announced a R$ 1.56 billion investment in basic healthcare for all 645 municipalities in São Paulo, divided into three fronts: IGM SUS Paulista (R$ 201 million), voluntary and compulsory transfers (R$ 600 million), and the SUS Paulista Table (R$ 760 million). The funds will be sent to Municipal Health Funds to improve medical care, expand exams and surgeries, and combat infant mortality and epidemiological outbreaks.

item.title: Caso Master: Daniel Vorcaro cita 'Dark Horse' e Ciro Nogueira em nova proposta de delação
item.description: Daniel Vorcaro's defense included in a new plea bargain proposal information about the financing of the film 'Dark Horse' on Jair Bolsonaro and his relationship with Senator Ciro Nogueira, but investigators say there are no new elements and the deal is likely to be rejected again. Vorcaro denies the film payments were bribes, despite Flávio Bolsonaro requesting funds for the production and Vorcaro having paid R$ 61 million. The PF had previously investigated Ciro Nogueira for allegedly favoring Banco Master, including sending legislative projects and paying a R$ 500 thousand monthly allowance.

item.title: Justiça Eleitoral suspender pesquisa năo é comum, mas também năo é raro, diz Azevedo Marques
item.description: Minister Floriano de Azevedo Marques of the TSE stated that while it is not common, it is also not rare for the Electoral Justice to suspend the dissemination of electoral polls following challenges by candidates. He noted that such challenges are frequent during campaigns. The remark was made at the Abranet congress in Brasília.

item.title: Papo Antagonista: Lula não vai à missa? Janja rebate Malafaia e PT convoca evangélicos
item.description: The PT released an open letter to evangelicals following the fourth National Meeting of the Party’s Evangelical Nucleus, criticizing pastors and religious leaders aligned with Bolsonarism for using religion as a tool of political manipulation. The document reaffirms the party’s commitment to secularism and religious freedom while seeking to engage with the traditionally conservative evangelical electorate.

item.title: “Lula está quebrando a economia do Brasil”, diz Renan Santos
item.description: Presidential pre-candidate Renan Santos (Missão) accused the Lula government of destroying Brazil's economy, citing the rising dollar, increasing inflation, growing expectations for interest rates, and declining economic indicators. He claims the country is already in an ongoing economic crisis and directly blames President Lula for the deterioration of macroeconomic fundamentals.

item.title: Ala do PT-SP deve intensificar pressão por Simone Tebet na vice de Haddad
item.description: A São Paulo PT wing is increasing pressure for Simone Tebet (PSB) to be chosen as Fernando Haddad’s running mate in the gubernatorial race, citing polls showing she draws more votes than Márcio França, along with her ministerial background and gender. Tebet, however, has ruled out the role, stating her focus is on running for Senate, for which she has already changed her electoral domicile and party. Although no meeting with Lula is scheduled, some PT members believe a new conversation with the president could persuade her to reconsider.

item.title: Exército suspende operações na fronteira após bloqueio no orçamento
item.description: The Army suspended specific border operations after President Lula blocked R$4.3 billion in the Defense budget, part of a broader R$23.7 billion cut in discretionary spending required by the fiscal framework. Permanent patrols and surveillance continue uninterrupted. Pre-candidates Flávio Bolsonaro and Ronaldo Caiado criticized the move, claiming it aids organized crime and undermines national sovereignty.

item.title: Conselho de Ética aprova afastamento de Pollon por xingar Motta
item.description: The Chamber of Deputies' Ethics Committee approved a 60-day suspension of Deputy Marcos Pollon (PL-MS) for breaching parliamentary decorum after he called Chamber President Hugo Motta a 'bosta' (a vulgar term) during an August 2025 event. The measure, based on a report by Deputy Ricardo Maia (MDB-BA), passed with 9 votes in favor and 4 against, but will not take effect immediately as Pollon may appeal to the Constitution and Justice Committee (CCJ).

item.title: Zanin restabelece condenação de homem que fez comentário racista ao recusar café
item.description: Supreme Court Minister Cristiano Zanin reinstated the racial injury conviction of a man who made racist remarks when refusing coffee offered by a woman in 2019. Zanin overturned the São Paulo Court of Justice's acquittal due to lack of proof of intent, emphasizing that 'recreational racism' cannot be excused as a joke and that the objective content of the speech suffices to constitute the crime.

item.title: O plano de Michelle Bolsonaro para envolver mulheres nas eleições de outubro
item.description: Michelle Bolsonaro will launch a PL Women's campaign urging female party members to volunteer as poll workers and supervisors in the October elections, aiming to expand the PL's presence across Brazilian electoral zones. The initiative seeks to offset her withdrawal from PL Women's activities following Jair Bolsonaro's November 2023 imprisonment, keeping the Bolsonaro family active on the ground as a counterweight to the Lula government's women's rights campaigns.

item.title: Motta abre trabalhos e CCJ adia mais uma vez votação de PEC da redução da maioridade penal
item.description: The Chamber’s Constitution and Justice Committee (CCJ) once again postponed voting on the PEC to reduce the age of criminal responsibility, after Chamber President Hugo Motta opened plenary proceedings, blocking committee consideration. The session featured solitary obstruction by Psol and tepid resistance from the PT, while the opposition accused Lula’s allies of blocking the proposal to prevent Bolsonarists from exploiting potential dissent within the governing coalition to boost Flávio Bolsonaro’s 2026 presidential pre-candidacy.

item.title: Documentos mostram como Vorcaro enviou R$ 61 milhões aos EUA para bancar ‘Dark Horse’, aponta site
item.description: Documents revealed by The Intercept show that Daniel Vorcaro sent at least US$10.6 million (R$61 million at the time's exchange rate) to the U.S. by May 2025 to finance the film 'Dark Horse', about the life of Jair Bolsonaro. The records include a payment spreadsheet and a SWIFT transfer confirmation, indicating funds were sent to Havengate Development Fund LP in Texas. Message exchanges between Vorcaro and Thiago Miranda suggest further disbursements were under discussion, reinforcing suspicions of illegal fund use in a cinematic project tied to the Bolsonaro family.

item.title: Ministro da Fazenda se reúne com Alcolumbre para tentar conter pauta-bomba de R$ 270 bilhões
item.description: Finance Minister Dario Durigan met with Senate President Davi Alcolumbre to try to block proposals with a fiscal impact exceeding R$ 270 billion, including rural debt renegotiation (R$ 120 billion), full retirement for health agents (R$ 99 billion), and a new minimum wage for doctors and dentists (R$ 47 billion). Despite tensions between Alcolumbre and the Lula government, Durigan is seen as one of the ministers with the best rapport with the senator. The measures are under Senate review and are viewed by the economic team as a threat to fiscal stability.

item.title: A nova pesquisa Nexus/BTG sobre a eleição presidencial, a 1ª após ameaça de tarifaço
item.description: The Nexus institute will release on Monday (15) a new presidential election poll with 2,000 interviews and a two-point margin of error. Commissioned by BTG Pactual, the survey will assess voter reaction to the U.S. threat of new tariffs on Brazilian goods, exploring whether voters blame Lula or Flávio Bolsonaro. In the May 25 poll, Lula led with 40% in the first round and would defeat Flávio Bolsonaro in a runoff by 47% to 43%.

item.title: Câmara analisa redução da maioridade penal, mas decisão antes da eleição é incerta, dizem analistas
item.description: The Constitution and Justice Committee of the Brazilian Chamber of Deputies is reviewing a constitutional amendment proposal to reduce the age of criminal responsibility to 16 years, with a favorable report from Deputy Coronel Assis. Experts describe the issue as electorally motivated and part of the broader public security debate, which is a central theme in the 2026 elections, while noting that youth involvement in crime has declined in recent years.

item.title: Ofensa a Motta: Conselho de Ética aprova parecer para suspender Pollon
item.description: The Chamber of Deputies' Ethics Committee approved a report recommending the three-month suspension of federal deputy Marcos Pollon (PL-MS) for offensive remarks against House President Hugo Motta (Republicanos-PB) during an event in Campo Grande. The vote was nine in favor and four against, marking the second time the committee has recommended Pollon's suspension, following a prior recommendation in May for his role in the Bolsonarist riot that occupied the Chamber's leadership board.

item.title: Conselho de Ética aprova suspensão de mandato de Marcos Pollon por 60 dias
item.description: The Chamber of Deputies' Ethics Council approved a 60-day suspension of Deputy Marcos Pollon's (PL-MS) mandate for making offensive remarks against Chamber President Hugo Motta. Pollon claims he is being punished for expressing his opinions and said he will appeal to the Constitution and Justice Committee (CCJ). The final decision rests with the Plenary, requiring an absolute majority of 257 deputies.

item.title: Governo deve aprovar em 15 dias aumento de etanol para 32% na gasolina
item.description: Minister of Mines and Energy Alexandre Silveira announced that the government will discuss within 15 days raising the mandatory ethanol blend in gasoline from 30% to 32% (E32) at the next CNPE meeting. The measure, backed by the ethanol sector, aims to reduce fuel import dependence, particularly amid international instability like the Iran war, and strengthen Brazil's energy security.

item.title: Motta pede ao governo para retirar urgência de projeto sobre o fim da escala 6x1, após Câmara aprovar PEC
item.description: Chamber President Hugo Motta asked the Lula government to withdraw the urgency regime for the bill ending the 6x1 work scale, after a constitutional amendment (PEC) on the topic was approved in the Chamber. Motta said the government has not yet given a firm response, and the proposal includes two weekly days off and a reduction of the workweek from 44 to 40 hours over 14 months. The PEC now moves to the Senate, where Senate President Davi Alcolumbre has not yet defined its processing path.

item.title: ONS agiu de forma pontual e assertiva para evitar apagão, diz Silveira
item.description: Minister Alexandre Silveira stated that the ONS acted promptly and decisively by activating the emergency plan to reduce energy generation due to a sudden drop in demand from low temperatures, preventing a blackout. He emphasized that the government restored power within six hours after the August 2023 blackout and guaranteed energy security for the next decade, citing investments in hydroelectric plants and thermal contracts to ensure affordable tariffs.

item.title: Wellington Dias liga para João Campos após ruído sobre palanque em PE
item.description: Minister Wellington Dias called Recife Mayor João Campos after causing dissatisfaction by stating Lula might split his agenda between Campos’ and Governor Raquel Lyra’s platforms. Dias clarified his remarks were misinterpreted, emphasizing Lula will have support from both, and reaffirmed the PT’s backing of Campos’ candidacy. The calls came on Monday and Tuesday (Sept 8-9) after Campos complained to PT president Edinho Silva.

item.title: Ala do TSE tenta encontrar 'meio termo' para decisão de Nunes Marques que suspendeu pesquisa eleitoral
item.description: A faction of Brazil's Superior Electoral Court (TSE) is seeking a 'middle ground' regarding the decision by court president Kassio Nunes Marques to suspend the release of the Atlas Intel poll following a request from Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL). The move sparked internal debate over balancing free speech and electoral integrity. Supporters of a compromise argue for refining the decision to avoid setting overly restrictive precedents while maintaining oversight of electoral polls.
